records.context: With ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (item 980) no AI is asked: every UniProt GO term and keyword of the screening experiment's genes, and every CORUM complex (``ops_voyager3_corum``) and Reactome pathway (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), is tested in each cluster by a one-sided hypergeometric test against all the screening experiment's genes, with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the cluster's terms. The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screening experiment's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. The same tables are written, plus ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; the reference files are copied with their checksum and date so a rerun works offline.

The best term at FDR at most ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, with at least 3 cluster genes and twice the screen's share, names the role; the share of cluster genes carrying it gives the same confidence words, and in high and medium clusters the genes without it are the candidates. records.translation: Med ``ops_voyager3_method`` ``'enrichment'`` (punkt 980) tillfrågas ingen AI: varje UniProt GO-term och nyckelord för screeningens gener, och varje CORUM-komplex (``ops_voyager3_corum``) och Reactome-signalväg (``ops_voyager3_reactome``), testas i varje kluster med ett ensidigt hypergeometriskt test mot alla screeningens gener, med Benjamini-Hochberg-FDR över klustrets termer. Den bästa termen med FDR högst ``ops_voyager3_enrichment_fdr``, med minst 3 klustergener och dubbla screeningens andel, namnger rollen; andelen klustergener som bär den ger samma konfidensord, och i high- och medium-kluster är generna utan den kandidaterna. Samma tabeller skrivs, plus ``voyager3_enrichment_terms.csv``; referensfilerna kopieras med sin kontrollsumma och sitt datum så att en ny körning fungerar offline.
